title: PEPTERGENT: A Peptide-Based Reagent for Detergent-Free Extraction of Membrane Proteins
author: Frank Antony

steps.title: Prepare all required solutions
steps.instruction: Make the following solutions exactly as described, using the indicated reagents, concentrations, volumes and storage conditions.

substeps.instruction: 6 M NaOH (250 mL): dissolve 60 g NaOH in distilled water and bring to 250 mL; store at room temperature.
6 M HCl (250 mL): mix 124 mL commercial 12.1 M HCl with 126 mL distilled water to 250 mL; store at room temperature.
20 % ethanol (250 mL): combine 50 mL 100 % ethanol with 200 mL distilled water; store at room temperature.
1 M Tris, pH 7.8 (500 mL): dissolve 60.57 g Tris, adjust pH with 6 M HCl, bring to 500 mL with distilled water; store at room temperature.
1 M NaCl (1 L): dissolve 58.44 g NaCl in distilled water to 1 L; store at room temperature.
50 % glycerol (200 mL): mix 100 mL 100 % glycerol with 100 mL distilled water; store at room temperature.
TS buffer (1 L): 50 mM Tris (50 mL 1 M Tris), 100 mM NaCl (100 mL 1 M NaCl), 850 mL distilled water; store at room temperature or 4 °C.
2× TS buffer (1 L): 100 mM Tris (100 mL 1 M Tris), 200 mM NaCl (200 mL 1 M NaCl), 700 mL distilled water; store at room temperature or 4 °C.
TSG buffer (1 L): 50 mM Tris (50 mL 1 M Tris), 100 mM NaCl (100 mL 1 M NaCl), 10 % glycerol (200 mL 50 % glycerol), 650 mL distilled water; store at room temperature or 4 °C.

LB media (1 L): 10 g tryptone, 5 g yeast extract, 10 g NaCl, bring to 1 L with distilled water; autoclave 120 °C 30 min, store at room temperature. If contamination occurs, add bleach (10 % of total volume), sit 30 min RT, drain and rinse 15 min with tap water.
50 mM ammonium bicarbonate (50 mL): dissolve 197.65 mg NH4HCO3 in distilled water to 50 mL; store at 4 °C.
2 M imidazole (50 mL): dissolve 6.8 g imidazole in distilled water to 50 mL; store at 4 °C.
Ni‑NTA elution buffer (10 mL): 5 mL 2× TS, 3 mL 2 M imidazole (600 mM final), 2 mL distilled water; store at 4 °C.
1 M PMSF (10 mL): dissolve 1.74 g PMSF in isopropanol, bring to 10 mL; store at –20 °C, use clear supernatant only.

0.5 M EDTA, pH 8.0 (50 mL): dissolve 9.3 g EDTA in 30 mL water, adjust pH to 8.0 with 6 M NaOH, add EDTA in 1 g increments with pH readjustments until total 9.3 g; bring to 50 mL with water; store at 4 °C.
100× protease inhibitor tablet (100 µL): dissolve 1 tablet in 500 µL distilled water; store at –20 °C (use same day if possible).
0.5 mg/mL MS‑grade protease (40 µL): dissolve 20 µg protease in 1 M Tris pH 7.8 to 40 µL; store at –20 °C (keep on ice if used within 1 h).
1 M DTT (100 µL): dissolve 15.42 mg DTT in HPLC‑grade water to 100 µL; prepare fresh day of use, keep on ice.
500 mM IAA (100 µL): dissolve 9.2 mg IAA in HPLC‑grade water to 100 µL; prepare fresh, keep on ice, protect from light.
10 mg/mL PDET‑1 (2 mL): dissolve 20 mg PDET‑1 in 1 M Tris pH 7.5, adjust volume with distilled water to 2 mL; store at 4 °C, check pH 5.0–10.0.
5 mg/mL HD‑43 (4 mL): dissolve 20 mg HD‑43 in 1 M Tris pH 7.5, adjust volume with distilled water to 4 mL; store at 4 °C, check pH 5.0–10.0.

Solubilization buffer (4 mL): mix 5 µL 10 mg/mL PDET‑1 (5 mg), 2 µL 5 mg/mL HD‑43 (10 mg), 200 µL 1 M Tris pH 7.8 (50 mM), 400 µL 1 M NaCl (100 mM), 8 µL 0.5 M EDTA (1 mM), 40 µL 100× protease inhibitor (1×), bring to 4 mL with distilled water; make fresh, keep on ice.
C18 resin slurry (600 µL): combine 200 µL C18 resin with 400 µL methanol; prepare just before use.
10 % formic acid (10 mL): dilute 1 mL 100 % formic acid with 9 mL HPLC‑grade water; store at 4 °C.
0.1 % formic acid (10 mL): dilute 100 µL 10 % formic acid with 9.9 mL water; store at 4 °C.
40 % acetonitrile, 0.1 % formic acid (10 mL): mix 4 mL 100 % acetonitrile, 100 µL 0.1 % formic acid, 5.9 mL water; store at 4 °C.
1× Bradford assay (50 mL): combine 10 mL protein assay dye concentrate with 40 mL distilled water; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Grow starter culture
steps.instruction: Ignite a CO₂‑connected Bunsen burner, add 50 mL LB to a sterile 125 mL Erlenmeyer flask, scrape a small frozen portion of the BL21 glycerol stock from –80 °C, drop it into the LB near the flame, turn off the burner, and incubate at 37 °C, 200 rpm for 12–16 h (OD₆₀₀ > 1.0).

steps.title: Inoculate main culture
steps.instruction: Near a lit Bunsen burner, transfer LB to a 1 L Erlenmeyer flask, measure 1 L using the flask’s graduations, add 10 mL starter culture, cover with aluminum foil, and incubate at 37 °C, 200 rpm for 8–16 h.

steps.title: Harvest cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 mL of the overnight culture into each of two 500 mL polypropylene centrifuge bottles (balance within 5 g), place them in a JLA‑10.500 rotor with opposite biosafety canisters and fill remaining slots with empty canisters, centrifuge at 6,000×g for 15 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend each pellet in 10 mL TSG buffer per L of original culture using a glass pestle and vortex.

substeps.instruction: Combine the two 10 mL suspensions in a 15 mL glass Douncer, add 1–2 mL extra TSG if needed, and dounce until homogeneous.
Transfer the homogenate to a 50 mL Falcon tube (rinse the Douncer with 1–2 mL TSG), then store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Thaw homogenate
steps.instruction: Remove the frozen homogenate from –20 °C and thaw on ice for ~30 min (or 5–10 min in room‑temperature water if time‑pressed).

steps.title: Prepare microfluidizer
steps.instruction: Insert the glass funnel into the M110L microfluidizer, pack the bed with ice, open the compressed‑air valve (keep air switch closed), set pressure to 12,000 psi, and flush three times with distilled water (each wash = three clicks). Discard the water.

steps.title: Lyse cells with microfluidizer
steps.instruction: Load the thawed homogenate into the funnel and pass the entire volume through the microfluidizer five times, collecting the output in a 50 mL Falcon tube each pass; after the fifth pass, flush the tubing with ~5 mL TSG buffer until clear, collecting all eluate on ice.

steps.title: Clean microfluidizer after use
steps.instruction: Perform three washes with distilled water (three clicks per wash), followed by three washes with 20 % ethanol, leave the system filled with 20 % ethanol, cap the intake funnel, and close the compressed‑air valve.

steps.title: Isolate crude membrane fraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the lysate into two 50 mL JA‑25.50 bottles, balance within 1 g, centrifuge at 4,350×g for 10 min (JA‑25.50 rotor) to pellet unlysed cells, discard supernatant, add an equal volume of bleach to the pellet, sit 30 min RT, dispose down drain and rinse 15 min with water.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the cleared lysate to two TI‑45 ultra‑clear round‑top bottles, fill to maximum volume (≤1 air bubble), and ultracentrifuge at 40,000 rpm (≈125,440×g) for 45 min at 750 vacuum.
Place tubes on ice, return rotor to cold room, keep the supernatant (store –20 °C) and the pellet (crude membrane).

steps.title: Resuspend crude membrane
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL TSG buffer per L of original LB culture (1 mL per TI‑45 bottle) to the membrane pellet, use a P1000 tip to loosen, cut the tip tip to widen, pipette up/down to break chunks, transfer all material to a 7 mL glass Douncer (add 250 µL TSG rinse), dounce until uniform, then transfer to a 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Measure protein concentration (Bradford)
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL 1× Bradford solution to four cuvettes; add 2 µL TSG to cuvette 1 (blank), 1 µL crude membrane to cuvette 2, 2 µL to cuvette 3, 3 µL to cuvette 4; mix with fresh P1000 tip each, place cuvettes in Genesys 10 spectrophotometer (slot B = blank, slots 1‑3 = samples), set wavelength 595 nm, curve fit Linear Through Zero, 5 standards, units mg/mL, run test, calculate average concentration (normalize slots 2 and 3 by dividing by 2 and 3 respectively, then average with slot 1). Record value on the tube and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Solubilize membrane with PDET‑1
steps.instruction: Thaw crude membrane on ice ~30 min (or 5–10 min in warm water). Prepare solubilization buffer, then resuspend 100 µL of 10 mg/mL crude membrane in 200 µL solubilization buffer and 300 µL TS buffer (final 500 µL, 1 mg membrane, 1 mg PDET‑1). Set aside 5 µL for SDS‑PAGE troubleshooting. Incubate on a rotisserie shaker in the cold room for 90 min.

steps.title: Clarify solubilized extract
steps.instruction: Transfer 250 µL of the suspension into each of two 1.5 mL TLA‑55 tubes, balance volumes, place tubes in a TLA‑55 fixed‑angle rotor, and centrifuge at 55,000 rpm (≈135,520×g) for 15 min. Collect the supernatant (PDET‑1 extract) in a new tube, keep the pellet for troubleshooting, and set aside 10 µL of supernatant for SDS‑PAGE.

steps.title: Peptide exchange with HD‑43
steps.instruction: Mix 500 µL PDET‑1 extract (≈1 mg PDET‑1) with 200 µL 5 mg/mL HD‑43 (≈1 mg HD‑43) to obtain a 1:1 mass ratio; if volumes differ, scale proportionally while keeping the ratio. Incubate on a rotisserie shaker in the cold room for 10 min.

steps.title: Prepare Ni‑NTA resin
steps.instruction: Pipette 200 µL Ni‑NTA slurry into a microcentrifuge tube using a cut P200 tip, centrifuge 2,000×g 2 min, carefully remove 30 % ethanol supernatant, resuspend resin in 500 µL distilled water, nutate 5 min RT, centrifuge 2,000×g 2 min, discard water, resuspend in 500 µL TS buffer, keep on nutator at RT.

steps.title: Bind exchange mixture to Ni‑NTA
steps.instruction: Add the 1:1 PDET‑1/HD‑43 extract (~3 mg protein) to the 100 µL packed Ni‑NTA resin (≈3 mg resin) in a microcentrifuge tube, adjust total volume to 500‑1000 µL with TS buffer if needed, and incubate on a rotisserie rotator in the cold room for 1 h (or overnight).

steps.title: Wash Ni‑NTA resin
steps.instruction: Perform three washes: add 1 mL TS buffer, rotate 5 min cold room, centrifuge 2,000×g 2 min, discard wash. Repeat two more times.

steps.title: Elute bound proteins
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL TS buffer containing 600 mM imidazole to the resin, rotate 10 min cold room, centrifuge 2,000×g 2 min, collect eluate (repeat if necessary to recover all liquid), keep 10 µL for SDS‑PAGE, and store remaining eluate at –20 °C (or 4 °C ≤1 week).

steps.title: Determine eluate concentration (Bradford)
steps.instruction: Use 3 µL TS buffer with 600 mM imidazole as blank; add 1, 3, and 5 µL eluate to separate 1 mL 1× Bradford solutions, run assay as described in step “Measure protein concentration (Bradford)”, and average the three readings.

steps.title: Normalize eluate to 100 µg
steps.instruction: Calculate the volume containing 100 µg protein from the Bradford result, dilute that volume to a final 100 µL with TS buffer, keep on ice; store the rest of the eluate at –20 °C (or 4 °C ≤1 week).

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE quality check
steps.instruction: Load 5 µL each of crude membrane, PDET‑1 extract, insoluble pellet (if applicable), Ni‑NTA flowthrough, and Ni‑NTA eluate onto a gel, run SDS‑PAGE, and verify successful preparation before proceeding to mass spectrometry.

steps.title: Bottom‑up MS sample preparation
steps.instruction: To 100 µL eluate (100 µg protein) add 36.7 mg urea (final 6 M), vortex, nutate 30 min RT; add 1 µL 1 M DTT (final 10 mM), nutate 1 h RT; add 4 µL 500 mM IAA (final 20 mM), nutate 30 min RT in dark; add 1 µL 1 M DTT (final 20 mM), nutate 30 min RT; add 500 µL 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate (dilute urea to 1 M); add 2 µL 0.5 µg/µL protease (1:100 ratio), nutate overnight RT; next day add another 2 µL protease (1:50 ratio), nutate overnight RT.

steps.title: Prepare C18 StageTips
steps.instruction: Cut the tip off a 200 µL pipette tip, insert a C18 SPE disk into an uncut tip using a gel‑loading tip, push disk to the bottom, and place the assembled tip into a pierced microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Condition StageTips
steps.instruction: Pipette 30 µL C18 resin slurry into each StageTip, centrifuge 2,000×g 2 min; add 75 µL methanol, centrifuge 2,000×g 2 min; wash twice with 100 µL 0.1 % formic acid, centrifuge 2,000×g 2 min each (extend to 5 min if flow incomplete).

steps.title: Adjust peptide sample pH
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL 10 % formic acid to the 600 µL trypsin‑digested sample, check pH with a 2.5–4.5 indicator strip, and add more formic acid if needed to reach pH 3.

steps.title: Load sample onto StageTips
steps.instruction: Load the acid‑adjusted digest onto the StageTip in 100 µL aliquots, centrifuge 2,000×g 2 min each, discarding flowthrough each time, until the entire volume is loaded. If flow slows, increase speed to 3,000×g or extend spin to 5 min; in worst case, gently push liquid through with a syringe.

steps.title: Wash and dry StageTips
steps.instruction: Wash resin three times with 100 µL 0.1 % formic acid (2 min centrifuge each), then perform a final dry spin 2,000×g 2 min to remove residual liquid.

steps.title: Elute peptides from StageTips
steps.instruction: Transfer StageTip to a new pierced tube and elute with three sequential 50 µL portions of 40 % acetonitrile in 0.1 % formic acid (centrifuge 2,000×g 2 min each), collecting a total of 150 µL eluate.

steps.title: Dry peptide eluate
steps.instruction: Place the 150 µL eluate in a lyophilizer/dryer with vacuum and low heat, keep the cap open, and dry until all liquid evaporates (2–4 h; can be overnight on low heat). Seal the tube with Parafilm and store for MS analysis.
